name: 9xpublishfast
description: Manual-first content distribution queue for X (Twitter) & social content

scripts.dev: npm run migrate -w server && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run migrate -w server && npm run start -w server
